policy: Three consecutive complete runs with seven repetitions per frozen and native profile; all results retained, third current. Stop on source/build/correctness/evidence/native-recorder failures; retain and report timing/allocation investigations. No accepted-reference advancement.
native_policy: Every full check automatically measures all eight native profiles. Freeze the first complete native capture as its own immutable feature baseline; compare subsequent matching profiles with it. This does not replace or advance the original or accepted performance references.

previous_stage_reference.purpose: Preserve every published Stage 2 PASS, including all prior Stage 1 improvements, and report incremental costs. The older accepted performance reference remains unchanged.

note: All declared final runs retained; third current. Original, accepted and first-native references unchanged. Deferred CDC/timeout failures and timing investigations remain visible. Local uncommitted review; no commit or push.
